blogs.title: TAV-in-TAV-in-TAV after treated PVE: When is a third transcatheter valve the right call?
blogs.description: Walk through the decision-making tensions of performing a third TAVI in a patient with prior TAV-in-TAV and a history of prosthetic valve endocarditis (PVE). We’ll juxtapose current ESC 2025 guidance favoring surgery for PVE against prohibitive surgical risk, infection resolution, and anatomy-driven feasibility. Practical pearls: confirming infection control (cultures, TEE, CT), timing reintervention post-antibiotics, shared decision-making, and how prior endocarditis should—and should not—drive the reintervention strategy once inactive.

blogs.title: CT as the playbook: Imaging strategy for TAV-in-TAV-in-TAV
blogs.description: Detail how preprocedural MSCT can de-risk a third TAVI: measuring valve-to-coronary distance, sinus dimensions, coronary heights, and frame–frame interactions; anticipating the neo-skirt; and simulating high implantation to preserve flow and access. We’ll outline a reproducible planning workflow, discuss when to forgo coronary protection, and highlight common CT pitfalls in layered valve anatomies.

blogs.title: Saving the coronaries in a triple-frame world: Commissural alignment, high implantation, and future access
blogs.description: Focus on coronary safety and reaccess across three overlapping frames. Topics include commissural alignment principles across platforms, deliberate high implantation to pin prior leaflets and minimize the neo-skirt, choosing platforms with favorable frame height/mesh geometry, and practicalities of post-TAVI coronary engagement. We’ll contrast strategies for immediate obstruction prevention versus preserving long-term PCI options.

blogs.title: PPM and gradients after redo TAVI: From scary day-0 numbers to stable mid-term hemodynamics
blogs.description: Use the case’s day-0 mean gradient of 67 mm Hg that fell to 26–27 mm Hg by 1 year to illustrate expected hemodynamic trajectories after triple-layered valves. We’ll review interpreting AVA, indexed AVA, and DVI in this setting; why early gradients can be misleading; the role of post-dilation and partial prior-frame expansion; indications and limits of valve fracture; and tactics to mitigate prosthesis–patient mismatch with supra-annular designs.

blogs.title: Picking the platform and nailing the deployment in tight, layered anatomies
blogs.description: Dissect the choice of Acurate neo2 (supra-annular leaflets, modest frame height, alignment-friendly) over alternatives in a narrow, triple-stented root. We’ll cover sizing off inner-frame dimensions, rapid pacing and balloon strategy (pre-/post-dilation), anchoring at the level of prior leaflets, and how different platforms (Lotus legacy, Evolut, Acurate) interact mechanically when stacked.

blogs.title: Life after serial TAVI and prior PVE: Surveillance, prevention, and planning for limited runway
blogs.description: Outline a pragmatic follow-up program after TAV-in-TAV-in-TAV with prior PVE: echo cadence and what to track (gradients, DVI, regurgitation, LV remodeling), triggers for advanced imaging, endocarditis prophylaxis considerations without chronic suppressive antibiotics, antithrombotic nuances in GI-bleeding-prone patients, and counseling around constrained future options (explant risk, BASILICA/valve fracture feasibility).
